columnPool.label: Route: Snow Hill Lines
columnPool.display: Is part of the Snow Hill Lines route
columnPool.hint: The umbrella name for the routes radiating from Birmingham Snow Hill and Moor Street stations, covering both the Stratford-upon-Avon branch (the Shakespeare Line) and the Kidderminster/Worcester branch.

columnPool.label: Route: Shakespeare Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Shakespeare Line route
columnPool.hint: The suburban line from Birmingham (via Snow Hill/Moor Street) south to Stratford-upon-Avon - also grouped under 'Snow Hill Lines' more broadly, one of the routes radiating from Snow Hill/Moor Street through the Warwickshire countryside.

columnPool.label: Route: Shrewsbury to Wolverhampton Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Shrewsbury to Wolverhampton Line route
columnPool.hint: The route linking Shrewsbury to Wolverhampton via Cosford, Telford Central and Oakengates - continuing onward to the Chase Line towards Rugeley.

columnPool.label: Route: Chiltern Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Chiltern Line route
columnPool.hint: The main route from London Marylebone to Birmingham via High Wycombe, Bicester and Banbury - Chiltern Railways' principal main line, with a branch via Aylesbury and Amersham.

columnPool.label: Route: Chase Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Chase Line route
columnPool.hint: The suburban line from Birmingham New Street via Walsall to Rugeley Trent Valley, named after Cannock Chase which it passes through at its northern end - fully electrified in 2018.

columnPool.label: Route: Cross-City
columnPool.display: Is part of the Cross-City route
columnPool.hint: The busy commuter line from Lichfield in the north through Birmingham New Street to Redditch and Bromsgrove in the south - one of the busiest commuter routes in the country outside London.

columnPool.label: Route: West Coast Main Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the West Coast Main Line route
columnPool.hint: The historic trunk route from London Euston to Glasgow via Rugby, Stafford, Crewe and Preston - Britain's busiest mixed-traffic main line.

columnPool.label: Route: Amersham Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Amersham Line route
columnPool.hint: The commuter branch from London Marylebone via Harrow-on-the-Hill to Amersham and on to Aylesbury - shares track with the London Underground Metropolitan line for part of its route.

columnPool.label: Route: Elephant & Bear Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Elephant & Bear Line route
columnPool.hint: The line from Royal Leamington Spa via Kenilworth and Coventry to Nuneaton - renamed from the 'NUCKLE' line in 2023 after a public vote, referencing the civic symbols of Coventry (elephant) and Warwick (bear).

columnPool.label: Route: Oxford Branch
columnPool.display: Is part of the Oxford Branch route
columnPool.hint: The short branch line from Bicester North via Islip and Oxford Parkway into Oxford itself.

columnPool.label: Route: Stratford Branch
columnPool.display: Is part of the Stratford Branch route
columnPool.hint: The branch line from Bearley (on the Birmingham-Stratford route) to Stratford-upon-Avon, also linking through to Lapworth on the Chiltern main line.

columnPool.label: Route: Cotswolds & Malverns Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Cotswolds & Malverns Line route
columnPool.hint: The long cross-country route from Oxford via Worcester and the Malvern Hills to Hereford - also known more locally as the Cotswold Line for its eastern Oxford-Worcester section.

columnPool.label: Route: Cross City Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Cross City Line route
columnPool.hint: This tag actually covers the brand-new Camp Hill Line stations (Kings Heath, Moseley Village, Pineapple Road) between Birmingham New Street and Kings Norton, reopened April 2026 after 80+ years closed - a distinct route from the main Cross-City Line despite the similar name in this dataset.
